primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The primary objective of this study was to evaluate the long-term safety of oral treprostinil in subjects with PH associated with HFpEF for subjects who completed Study TDE-HF-301. The number of subjects with adverse events during the study is reported as the primary outcome measure, which was the only outcome measurement reported for this Sponsor-terminated study.
